name: Open Hearts on Fire
source:
When an explosion rocks Edenbrook, Dr. Ethan Ramsey must stubbornly work together with the also stubborn firefighter chief in order to save the day.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Open_Hearts_on_Fire]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
当一场剧烈爆炸震动伊登布鲁克时，脾气倔强的伊森·拉姆齐医生不得不与同样固执己见的消防大队长携手合作，力挽狂澜。

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Open_Hearts_on_Fire]Choices Wikia[/url]]
